0022600182.text: The Denver Nuggets (3-3, 10th in the West) host the Toronto Raptors (4-3, 4th in the East) in a matchup where the Nuggets are coming off a loss and the Raptors have won their last game. Denver has won both 2025-26 meetings 2-0, most recently 121-115 in Denver, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring) are out for the Nuggets, while Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and for Toronto, Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) are out, with Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation) day-to-day and a game-time decision.
